title: Origin story: Paleshadow
description: Paleshadow was a city watch investigator who only worked nights, and learned to read moonlight the way others read footprints. She solves the crimes the day watch abandons — the vanished, the haunted, the impossible — and her reports are written in silver ink that only shows by moonlight.

title: Ability profile: Paleshadow

title: Power ranking: Paleshadow
description: Powers: Moonlight reveals truth to her; Her silver-ink reports; The night confides in her.

title: Stamina feats: Paleshadow
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Worked nights for thirty years; Followed cold trails for months.
